list.title: Exercises
list.subtitle: The movement library every workout is built from. An exercise reaches clients only once you publish it.
list.empty: The library is empty. Add the first exercise — workouts are assembled from these.

mode.label: Measured in
mode.hint: What the builder offers by default. A squat is reps, a plank is time — still changeable per workout.

form.basicsHint: Name and slug. The slug is frozen once saved.
form.tagsHint: These drive the library filters and the equipment the builder offers.
form.titleHint: Serbian is required — it is what every other language falls back to.
form.slugHint: Leave empty to derive it from the name.
form.slugLocked: The slug never changes — workouts and saved filters point at it.
form.descriptionHint: How the movement is performed. The client reads it next to the video.
form.cuesHint: One short line shown over the player during a set: “elbows tucked”.
form.unilateralHint: Done one side at a time, so it takes twice as long in a session.
form.musclesHint: The star marks a primary mover — it is listed first in the library.
form.noOptions: This vocabulary is empty — items are added in Configuration.
form.publishHint: A published exercise is visible to clients and can go into a workout.
form.deleteConfirm: Delete this exercise? Its video goes with it and this cannot be undone.

video.title: Demo video
video.hint: MP4, MOV or WebM, up to 50 MB. A 20–30 second clip is enough — longer does not fit the limit.
video.empty: No video yet. The exercise can be saved without one.
video.previewFailed: Could not open the video. Refresh the page and try again.
video.tooLarge: The file is over 50 MB. Compress it or trim the clip.
video.wrongType: Only MP4, MOV and WebM are supported.
video.notReady: The video is not ready yet — wait for the upload to finish.

errors.not_admin: You are not allowed to make this change.
errors.invalid_slug: A slug may only contain lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
errors.invalid_tag: One of the selected tags no longer exists. Refresh the page.
errors.video_not_ready: The exercise cannot be published until the video finishes uploading.
errors.video_type: That file type is not supported.
errors.upload_failed: The upload failed. Check your connection and try again.
